Class TreePlanter

java.lang.Object
solvers.queueingnet.treeAlgorithms.TreePlanter
public class TreePlanter extends Object
Class responsible for the tree planting phase of the Tree Convolution algorithm.
Author:
Ben Homer, 2014.

    • runTreePlantingPhase

      public boolean runTreePlantingPhase()
      Runs the main tree planting phase. Consists of two steps: 1. Plant the tree. 2. Check this tree has acceptable complexity characteristics, if not go back to step 1.
      Returns:
      A boolean indicating whether an adequate tree was found.

    • createTreeWithClonedStation

      public Node createTreeWithClonedStation(int m)
      Creates a copy of the current tree with station m cloned as an additional leaf node. In the Lam/Lien paper this is referred to as the Gm+ tree.
      Parameters:
      m - The station/queue to clone in the tree.
      Returns:
      The parent node of the two cloned nodes.

    • createTreeWithRemovedStation

      public Node createTreeWithRemovedStation(int m)
      Creates a copy of the current tree with the node for station m removed. In the Lam/Lien paper this is referred to as the Gm- tree.
      Parameters:
      m - The station/queue to remove from the tree.
      Returns:
      The parent node of the removed node.
